text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 144 tablets of amiodarone hydrochloride 200 mg (9.8 days of supply) and Corvale General holds 268 tablets (17.8 days). Both sites' inventory is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) per NDC 71335194204. Alternate manufacturers Advagen Pharma Limited, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, AvPAK, and Chartwell RX, LLC are not on the FDA shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could place.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include amiodarone hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21. The Bryant Ranch Prepack plant's most recent FDA inspection ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale East is below the two-week target. Corvale General can support a transfer while maintaining approximately two weeks on hand. Alternate manufacturers are available for purchase but their supply chain visibility is limited.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 57 tablets of 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval.
2. Evaluate purchase from Advagen Pharma Limited — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from AvPAK — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Chartwell RX, LLC — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
